summary: Complete frontend testing of GlassMorph product family (7 pages). All 12 features tested and working correctly. All pages load with proper data-testid, violet/purple accent colors, and expected sections.

features_tested.feature: /glassmorph landing page loads with hero, stats, product grid, applications, FAQs, and CTA sections
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='glassmorph-landing', hero with 'GlassMorph' title, 'Make Glass Do More' tagline, stats (99% UV, 95% Transparency, 75% Energy, 5W/m²), 6 product cards, applications gallery, FAQs section, CTA section, and links to other product lines

features_tested.feature: GlassMorph navigation link appears in navbar with violet color
features_tested.details: data-testid='nav-glassmorph' present in navbar with violet/purple color (rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.8)), navigates to /glassmorph correctly

features_tested.feature: /glassmorph/smart-film detail page loads with hero, specs, features, variants table, and FAQs
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='smart-film-page', hero, quick specs (90-92%, 3%, 99%, 5W/m²), 6 features, variants table with 5 variants, applications gallery, specifications, FAQs

features_tested.feature: /glassmorph/led-film detail page loads with hero, specs, features, use cases, and FAQs
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='led-film-page', hero, quick specs (2mm, 95-99%, 5500 nits, 75%), features, use cases section (#use-cases), specifications, FAQs
Page loads with data-testid='media-glass-page', hero, specs (160°, 85%, 6000 nits), features, variants section (#variants), specifications, FAQs
Page loads with data-testid='switchable-glass-page', hero, specs (99%+, 5W/m², 20%, 20+ yrs), features, variants section (#variants), specifications, FAQs
Page loads with data-testid='flying-display-page', hero, specs (5×15m, 250g/m², 2mm, 95%+), features, use cases section (#use-cases), specifications, FAQs
Page loads with data-testid='hanging-led-page', hero, specs (95%, <1kg/m², 75%, 100k+ hrs), features, specifications section (#specs), FAQs

features_tested.feature: Product cards on landing page link to correct detail pages
features_tested.details: All 6 product card links found and verified: /glassmorph/smart-film, /glassmorph/led-film, /glassmorph/media-glass, /glassmorph/switchable-glass, /glassmorph/flying-display, /glassmorph/hanging-led

features_tested.feature: Cross-linking between GlassMorph product pages works
features_tested.details: Smart Film page links to LED Film and Switchable Glass; LED Film page links to Media Glass and Smart Film. Cross-navigation tested and working

features_tested.feature: Back to GlassMorph link on detail pages works
features_tested.details: All 6 detail pages have 'All GlassMorph Products' link (href='/glassmorph') that navigates back to landing page

features_tested.feature: Links to other product lines (LumiMorph, NaturaTex, SignaTouch) from landing page work
features_tested.details: Found all 3 links: /lumimorph, /naturatex, /signatouch in 'Other Product Lines' section

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warning about HTML nesting (span inside tbody) in SmartFilmPage.js variants table - FadeIn wrapper around <tr> elements causes invalid HTML structure. Does not affect functionality but should be addressed for HTML validity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GlassMorph product family has 7 pages: 1) Landing page at /glassmorph with product cards linking to detail pages, 2) Smart Film at /glassmorph/smart-film, 3) LED Film at /glassmorph/led-film, 4) Media Glass at /glassmorph/media-glass, 5) Switchable Glass at /glassmorph/switchable-glass, 6) Flying Display at /glassmorph/flying-display, 7) Hanging LED at /glassmorph/hanging-led. All pages have cross-links to each other and back to landing. No backend API - all content is static. Uses violet/purple accent colors (#8B5CF6). AI-generated images hosted on static.prod-images.emergentagent.com.
